How it worksPricing

    Why AwardPay

    Why AwardPay exists

    Working out your correct pay under a Modern Award shouldn't take a law degree. We make it simple — so you know exactly what you're owed.

    The problem

    • Modern Awards are complex: hundreds of rates, penalties and allowances
    • Penalties change by the day and the time of day
    • Small errors in overtime or allowances quietly add up over months
    • Most workers never realise they've been short-changed
    $1,527
    lost by the average underpaid worker each year

    What AwardPay does

    • Reads your payslip in about a minute
    • Checks it against official Fair Work Commission rates
    • Flags any missing penalties, overtime or allowances
    • Shows you exactly what you may be owed

    Where our data comes from

    Built on the Fair Work Commission's official Modern Award data, updated as rates change. AwardPay is an interpretation tool, not legal advice.

    Who it's for

    Any role under a Modern Award — retail, hospitality, construction, health, trades, cleaning, support work and more.

    See what you're owed

    AwardPay for Employers

    Pay your people right. Know where you stand.

    From hiring your first employee to reviewing your payroll, AwardPay helps Australian businesses understand the awards, classifications, pay rates and entitlements that may apply.

    We do the award research, so you don't have to.

    Request an Employer Review

    How we can help

    New employee award and classification research

    Hiring someone new? We research which award or agreement may apply, the likely classification, and the minimum rates, penalties and allowances to consider.

    Existing employee pay and entitlement reviews

    We review how current employees are paid against the award considerations that may apply to their role, hours and arrangements.

    Payroll compliance risk reviews

    A scoped look at your pay setup to highlight areas of potential risk, such as overtime, weekend penalties or missed allowances.

    What you receive

    A written report covering, as relevant to the agreed scope:

    • The research we performed
    • Applicable award or agreement considerations
    • Classifications
    • Minimum rates
    • Penalties and overtime
    • Allowances
    • Findings
    • Limitations
    • Recommended next steps

    How it works

    1. 1Enquire
    2. 2We review your requirements
    3. 3Receive a quote
    4. 4Research and written findings

    Each review is scoped and human-reviewed. We confirm whether we can help before quoting. Our findings are research and general guidance, not legal advice, and are not a guarantee or certification of compliance.

    Request an Employer Review

    Tell us what you need. There's no obligation — we'll reply with questions or a quote.

    Please don't include payslips, tax file numbers or employees' personal details. We'll ask for what we need once the scope is agreed.

    Questions first? Email support@awardpay.com.au
